scope: historical DEV 2023-01-03 through 2024-12-31; 2022 observations used only as feature warmup; no 2025+ values

data_quality.input: curve_contract_daily.csv supplied derived panel, not original exchange byte audit
checks: product-day coverage against supplied official calendar

statistical_factor.feature: log settlement(t)/settlement(t-20 official days) for the same exact contract
statistical_factor.label: log settlement(t+6)/settlement(t+1), same contract
statistical_factor.selection: eligible_curve_contract=True, maximum t open_interest per product; ties exact_contract ascending
metrics: daily top2 minus bottom2 forward log-return spread
statistical_factor.precision: float64 stdlib calculation; published decimal metrics rounded half-even to 12 decimal places; no hypothesis test or annualization
statistical_factor.missing: no fill; reject sample if any required t-20 through t+6 official-day settlement missing/nonpositive or availability-day unavailable
statistical_factor.claims: historical exploratory statistical exercise only, no execution PnL, no confirmation or historical collector availability proof

trading_backtest.criteria: six input hashes match archived replay, 603 corrected events, output comparison to historical frozen replay; STOP_ECONOMIC_GATE is expected scientific outcome not tool failure
trading_backtest.forbidden: no parameter tuning, no new trades, no 2025+

case_acceptance: protocol expression and reproducible historical calculation only; not strategy acceptance, protocol freeze or Phase0 closure
